status: DRAFT, awaiting user sign-off; not frozen. No signal-to-return relationship has been examined (OEE-0 reported coverage only).

events.admission: status ok; straddle exit priced; no split between entry and reaction; no entry-day IV crush flag; front expiry <= 7 calendar days after the reaction day; ATM straddle >= $0.50; both ATM legs volume >= 10 on the entry day
events.timing: entry at the entry day's close (last close before the 8-K acceptance), exit at the reaction day's close; release dates are assumed known at least 5 trading days ahead (companies announce them weeks in advance; our data records only the release)

pricing.prices: OPRA daily last-trade closes of the exact contracts (not mids)
pricing.costs: each leg pays a half-spread on entry and exit: half of the V8 option spread-model bucket median (nn_meta/validation/v8-spreads-option-20261008-r0/model.json; price x DTE x moneyness at that day); primary k = 1.0, stress k = 1.5; $0.05 per contract per side. Contracts expiring on the reaction day exit at intrinsic value and still pay the exit half-spread (closed before expiry, conservative)
pricing.return_unit: net P&L divided by premium paid (long structures) or by maximum loss (short defined-risk structures)

trailing_terciles: a feature's tercile is set against all admitted events with entry days in the prior 365 calendar days (>= 30 events, else no trade), as V8 H1; 2022 is burn-in for thresholds and per-ticker histories

H1_direction.question: Does a pre-release direction score predict the sign of the reaction?
H1_direction.trade: top tercile: buy the 0.5-delta call; bottom tercile: buy the 0.5-delta put (front expiry)

components.sue: SUE of the most recent first-reported quarterly diluted EPS public before entry (nn_meta.v8_event_signals.sue_table), at most 200 days old
components.revenue_accel: YoY growth of the latest first-reported quarterly revenue (Revenues / RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax / SalesRevenueNet, 80-100 day duration) minus the same for the previous quarter; public before entry, at most 200 days old
components.momentum: ln(adj close at entry / adj close 20 trading days earlier) minus the same for QQQ
components.skew: -(IV of the ~0.95 put minus IV of the ~1.05 call), front expiry at entry (a cheap put wing is read as bullish; Xing, Zhang & Zhao 2010)

variants.H1a_combined: mean of the available components' trailing percentiles minus 0.5 (>= 2 components present)

H2_iv_runup.question: The user's observation: does a large IV build in the week before earnings precede a smaller move relative to the implied move, and a small build a bigger one?
H2_iv_runup.feature: iv_runup = front-expiry ATM IV at entry / the same expiry's ATM IV 5 trading days earlier - 1

variants.H2a_low_runup_long_straddle: bottom tercile: buy the ATM straddle
variants.H2b_high_runup_short_fly: top tercile: short iron butterfly: sell the ATM straddle, buy the listed call and put wings nearest strike +/- implied move x spot (at least one strike away); return on maximum loss

H2_iv_runup.monotone_requirement: dev mean of |realized move| / implied move strictly decreases from the low to the high run-up tercile

H3_cheap_move.question: Is the implied move cheap versus the stock's own past earnings moves?
H3_cheap_move.feature: ratio = implied move / median |realized move| of the ticker's previous 4-8 admitted events (requires >= 4)

variants.H3a_cheap_tercile: bottom trailing tercile of the ratio: buy the ATM straddle

evaluation.dev: entries 2022-03-01 .. 2025-12-31; folds are the six half-years 2023H1 .. 2025H2 by entry date (2022 burn-in)

pass_all_required_in_dev.edge: mean net per-trade return > 0 at k = 1.0 with t >= 2, standard errors clustered by reaction day (same-day events are correlated)
pass_all_required_in_dev.multiple_testing: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 across the 8 variants
pass_all_required_in_dev.folds: mean net per-trade return positive in >= 4 of the 6 folds
pass_all_required_in_dev.cost_stress: mean > 0 with clustered t >= 2 at k = 1.5

evaluation.reported_not_gating: trade count, hit rate, payoff quantiles, a fixed-1%-premium book's Sharpe and maximum drawdown, results by release session
evaluation.confirmation: 2026-01-02 .. 2026-09-14 (holdout partially used by V8 H1 stock; OEE trades different instruments on different dates); run only the variants that pass dev; pass = mean net per-trade return > 0 with clustered t >= 1 at k = 1.0
evaluation.single_run: dev runs once and is reported whatever the outcome; no re-tuning after seeing results

sizing_after_pass: OEE-3 only, from out-of-sample per-trade returns: half Kelly (f = 0.5 x mean / variance of return on premium), at most 2% of equity premium per position and 10% total premium at risk on any one day's events (worst case for the day: -10%); drawdown brake halves sizing at -15% and stops new entries at -20%
limitations: last-trade closes can be minutes stale relative to the 16:00 stock close; entry-day spreads before earnings are likely wider than the bucket medians (k = 1.5 stress, and V8 H1 paper fills will calibrate)
8-K acceptance can trail the press release; 10 events with an entry-day IV crush are excluded
XYZ (Square) before 2025 has no chain (old root SQ); foreign filers (6-K) have no events
no early exits: every trade is held from entry close to reaction close
